bind_address.description: IP address to bind the web server to.

web_port.description: TCP port for the main web API and UI.

use_unix_socket.description: Enable Unix socket listener instead of TCP.

unix_socket_path.description: Path for the Unix socket (used only if use_unix_socket is true).

db_host.description: Hostname or IP address of PostgreSQL server (leave empty if using socket).

db_port.description: PostgreSQL port (ignored if db_socket is set).

db_socket.description: Path to PostgreSQL socket directory (e.g., '/var/run/postgresql'). Overrides db_host/db_port.

db_password.description: Password for PostgreSQL user (optional, may be omitted if peer auth or .pgpass is used).

use_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for the web interface.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

ssl_ca_cert.description: Optional path to CA certificate for client cert verification.

enable_opaques_auth.description: Use internal Goiardi (opaq) user auth instead of LDAP.

ldap_url.description: LDAP server URL (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com). Required if using LDAP auth.

ldap_binddn.description: DN used to bind to the LDAP server for user lookups.

ldap_bindpw.description: Password for ldap_binddn (optional, may be omitted if anonymous bind is allowed).

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP filter to locate a user by username.

ldap_group_filter.description: Filter to check group membership for Chef admin roles.

file_backend.description: Backend for storing file uploads (nodes, cookbooks, etc.).

s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket name (required if using S3 backend).

s3_access_key.description: S3 access key (optional if IAM role is used).

s3_secret_key.description: S3 secret key (optional if IAM role is used).

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of concurrent cookbook/node uploads.

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of nodes the server will manage.

max_search_results.description: Maximum results returned per search query.

text_search_enabled.description: Enable text search functionality (requires PostgreSQL full-text indexing).
